_notes: 19059/19068: Based on Is 35:3-4 (思高: 你们应加强痿弱的手; 他要亲自来拯救你们) adapted as Advent antiphon — liturgical paraphrase not verbatim quote; 'manus dissolútas' = 痿弱的手 follows 思高 wording. 19060/19069/19076: 'Dóminus ultiónis' = 上主 (YHWH/Lord of vengeance) per 思高 convention. 19063/19072: Apoc 22:12 (思高: 我快要来。我随身带着报酬，要按照各人的行为还报各人) — 'dicit Dominus' added in antiphon, Dominus=上主 here as Lord (biblical). 19064/19073/19079: Lk 1:28 思高 = 「万福！充满恩宠者，上主与你同在！」(bracketed: 在女人中你是蒙祝福的) — antiphon combines v.28 with v.42b 'benedícta tu inter mulieres'; 19079 'in mulíeres' is a textual variant of 'inter mulieres', translated identically. 19065/19074: Liturgical elaboration on Lk 1:29 (conturbata: 惊惶不安 per 思高 v.29); 'claustrum virginitatis' = 童贞之封印, liturgical phrase not in 思高. 19077: 'qui cito véniet salus tua' — 'qui' appears to be a copyist variant of 'quia'; translated as 'quia' (因为) for sense. 19078: Is 16:1 思高 = 那地的主宰从旷野的磐石，应传达一言，至熙雍女儿的山岭 — antiphon uses abbreviated form; translated accordingly.
